results.title: Sports: A Conversation with Athens Hornets Coach Zac Harrell
results.description: The Athens Hornets took command from the outset Friday in a 70-14 win over Brownsboro.

results.title: Man City beaten by PSG in enthralling game as Pep returns to Etihad
results.description: Manchester City were beaten 4-2 by a majestic Paris Saint-Germain side as Pep Guardiola watched on from the stands in an enthralling Champions League encounter.

results.title: Aston Villa hit Fenerbahce for six in big win at Villa Park
results.description: Aston Villa dismantled Fenerbahce with Nicolas Jackson and Ross Barkley scoring two each in a 6-0 Champions League win at Villa Park.

results.title: BYU-Notre Dame ranks among college football’s most expensive tickets this weekend
results.description: BYU-Notre Dame tickets rank as college football’s second-most expensive this weekend, with a $429 get-in price and College GameDay coming to Provo.
